blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: LLM ensemble gains are often measured against a single baseline, but the value attributed to additional candidates can change with the comparison used. We study an LLM aggregator under four matched conditions: Direct (no candidates), Single-slot (one candidate in a multi-slot interface), Duplicate (one candidate repeated), and Multi-candidate (separately generated candidates). Under either non-diverse control, overall candidate gain (CIV) splits algebraically into an additional-candidate contrast (DSV) and a candidate-context contrast (CCV); the split, but not CIV, depends on the chosen control. On MultiHopRAG model diversity (k=2), the repetition gap Rep=-8.33 pp [-13.25, -3.75] quantifies the difference between gains measured against Duplicate and Single-slot. On a matched FRAMES stronger-panel extension (n=200, k=3, aggregator output limit 4096), paired Delta Rep=+9.67 pp [+6.00, +13.50]; within panels, Rep changes sign (original -6.33; stronger +3.33). In FRAMES evidence aggregation, candidate-context contrasts remain strongly negative under both non-diverse controls. Our results show why ensemble evaluations should state the reference control before attributing gains to additional candidates.
blocks.zh: LLM 综艺增益常以单一的基准来衡量,但附加候选方的归属值会随着使用的比较而改变. 我们在四个相应条件下研究LLM汇总器:直接(无候选人),单相位(多相位界面中一名候选人),重复(重复一名候选人)和多相位(单独产生候选人)。 在非二相控制下,总的候选者增益(CIV)在代数上分裂为附加的候选者对比(DSV)和候选者-候选者对比(CCV);分出而非CIV取决于所选择的控制. 在MultiHopRAG模型多样性(k=2)上,重复差距Rep=-8.33 pp [13.25,-3.75]量化了相对于重复和单相位的增益之差. 在匹配的FRAMES更强小板扩展(n=200,k=3,聚合输出限制为4096)上,成对的Delta Rep=+9.67pp [+6.00,+13.50];在面板内,Rep更改符号(原-6.33;更强的+3.33). 在FRAMES证据汇总中,在两种非相向控制下,候选文本对比仍然非常负面。 我们的结果显示,为什么共同评价应说明参考控制,然后才将收益分配给其他候选人。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Work on LLM ensembles usually asks whether more samples, models, or evidence raise final accuracy ( Wang et al., 2023 ; Du et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2024 ) .
Beyond majority voting, Universal Self-Consistency uses an LLM to select among free-form candidate answers ( Chen et al., 2023 ) , while LLM-Blender ranks and fuses outputs from different models ( Jiang et al., 2023 ) .
These methods show that combining candidates involves a decision about how their information is used.
Adding models is not always beneficial ( Li et al., 2025 ; Kim et al., 2026 ) .
Multi-agent debate also does not consistently outperform simpler self-consistency or ensembling methods ( Smit et al., 2024 ) .
This makes it important to distinguish the value of additional candidates from the behavior of the system that combines them.
A separate audit finds that common diversity metrics often re-express capability, and that latent complementarity rarely becomes majority-vote gain ( Kim, 2026a ) .
In tool-mediated industrial diagnosis, specialist information likewise need not turn into a matching gain for an LLM integrator ( Kim, 2026c ) .

有关LLM综艺的工作通常会询问更多的样本,模型,或证据是否提高最终准确性(Wang等,2023;Du等,2023;Wang等,2024;Li等,2024).
除了多数投票之外,普遍自足还使用LLM在自由形式候选人答案中进行选择(Chen等,2023年),而LLM-Blender则从不同模型中排出并引信输出(Jiang等,2023年).
这些方法表明,合并候选人需要决定如何使用他们的信息。
添加模型并不总是有利的(Li等,2025;Kim等,2026)。
多剂辩论也并非一贯比简单的自相容性或综艺方法要好(Smit等,2024.).
这使得必须区分额外候选人的价值与结合他们的系统的行为.
一项单独的审计发现,共同的多样性衡量标准常常会重新表达能力,潜在的互补性很少成为多数投票收益(Kim, 2026a)。
在以工具为媒介的工业诊断中,专家信息同样不需要变成LLM整合器的匹配增益(Kim, 2026c).

blocks.en:
Overall accuracy alone does not reveal why an ensemble succeeds or fails.
This is a longstanding issue in ensemble learning.
Classical work relates ensemble error to diversity among predictors ( Krogh and Vedelsby, 1994 ; Brown et al., 2005 ) .
More recently, Choi et al. (2025) separate the effects of voting and debate, while Ali (2026) decomposes majority-vote gains into rescued and damaged predictions.
These studies show why aggregate performance can hide important differences between ensemble mechanisms.
We do not claim to be the first decomposition of ensemble gains.
Our contribution is a matched set of answer-level controls for an LLM aggregator that can generate a new answer rather than only selecting a member prediction.
We test whether Duplicate and Single-slot, two plausible non-diverse controls, yield the same attribution of candidate value; they do not, and their accuracy gap changes sign between the evaluated candidate-generation configurations.

光是总体准确性并不能说明一个综艺节目成功或失败的原因。
这是一个长期存在的共同学习问题。
古典工作涉及预测者之间多样性的共性错误(克罗克和维德尔斯比,1994年;布朗等,2005年)。
最近,Choi等(2025年)将投票和辩论的效果分开,而Ali(2026年)则将多数选票得分分分解为被拯救和被破坏的预测.
这些研究显示,总性能为什么能够掩盖综艺机制之间的重要差异.

我们的贡献是一组对应的LLM聚合器的解答级别控件,它可以生成一个新的答案,而不只是选择一个成员的预测.
我们检验的是重复和单相机,两个可信的非二相控制,是否产生相同的候选人价值归属;它们没有,其准确性差距在被评价的候选人生成配置之间会发生变化。

blocks.en: We organize the measurement around four questions: 1. Does a Multi-candidate panel help relative to Direct solving (no candidate answers)? 2. How does Multi-candidate compare with Single-slot , which places one candidate in the same multi-slot interface? 3. How does that comparison change when the baseline is Duplicate , which repeats one candidate across slots? 4. What does the gap between Duplicate and Single-slot reveal about the attributed value of additional candidates? The central empirical finding is that the value attributed to additional candidates depends on the non-diverse control .

blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:

blocks.en: 7 Discussion and Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 讨论和结论

blocks.en: The results imply several practices for ensemble evaluation and design.
blocks.zh: 其结果意味着进行共同评价和设计的若干做法。

blocks.en:
A diversity-related gain should state whether it is measured over Single-slot or Duplicate.
On MultiHop model diversity ( k = 2 k{=}2 ) and the matched FRAMES stronger-panel extension ( k = 3 k{=}3 ), DSV dup \mathrm{DSV}_{\mathrm{dup}} and DSV slot \mathrm{DSV}_{\mathrm{slot}} tell different design stories.
If gain over Duplicate is large while gain over Single-slot is not, adding more models is not automatically justified by the Duplicate-relative number alone.
blocks.zh:
与多样性有关的收益应说明它是在单片地上衡量还是重复。
在MultiHop模型多样性(k = 2 k{=}2)和相匹配的FRAMES更强平面扩展(k = 3 k{=}3)上,DSV dup\mathrm{DSV}_{\mathrm{dup}和DSV槽\mathrm{DSV}_{\mathrm{slot}讲述不同的设计故事.
如果增益大于重复,而增益大于 Single-slot 不,增加更多的模型不能自动由重复相对数单独证明.

blocks.en:
Matched FRAMES results show that Rep can change sign between candidate-generation configurations.
This does not establish a universal causal mechanism for the sign change.
blocks.zh:
匹配的FRAMES结果显示Rep可以在候选生成配置之间更改签名.
这并没有为标志变化建立普遍因果机制.

blocks.en: Improving the candidate-generation configuration can raise CIV without producing the same increase under every diversity-related contrast.
blocks.zh: 改进候选人生成配置可以提高CIV,而不会在与多样性有关的每一种对比下产生同样的增长.

blocks.en: Evidence can be lost through candidate answers or aggregation; on FRAMES, restoring RAW beside candidates recovers most of the observed gap. MultiHop recovery is only partial.
blocks.zh: 证据可能会通过候选人的答案或汇总而丢失;在FRAMES上,在候选人之外恢复RAW可以弥补大部分观察到的差距. 多Hop恢复只是局部的.

blocks.en:
Holding candidate content fixed, the Luna-versus-Qwen3-32B evidence CIV gap is + 12.59 +12.59 pp [ + 4.07 , + 21.11 ] [+4.07,+21.11] on FRAMES and + 11.0 +11.0 pp [ + 4.67 , + 17.67 ] [+4.67,+17.67] on MultiHop.
These observed configuration differences show that generating candidates and realizing their information with an aggregator are distinct design questions.
They are not equal-decoding/equal-reasoning model-only interventions, do not establish Qwen Rep, and do not imply a universal ordering.

这些观察到的配置差异表明,用聚合器生成候选人并实现他们的信息是不同的设计问题。
它们不是平等解码/平等合理模式的唯一干预措施,不建立Quen Rep,也不意味着普遍命令。

blocks.en:
Figure 6 (Appendix F ) compares the plotted deployment cost and accuracy of the observed policies.
In its evidence-backed panel, Direct has higher plotted accuracy at lower plotted cost than the displayed M, E, and M+E candidate-based policies, illustrating why a diversity-related DSV contrast alone does not establish that extra candidate-generation and aggregation calls are worthwhile compared with Direct.
These are descriptive within-panel comparisons: policies use different token limits, and C2 PRO also changes model setup, so Figure 6 does not establish a general cost-optimal or equal-reasoning-budget policy.
blocks.zh:
图6(附录F)比较了所观察政策的精心规划的部署成本和准确性。
在其证据支持的面板中,Direct以较低的平面成本绘制了精确度,比显示的基于M、E和M+E候选人的政策要高,说明为什么仅与多样性有关的DSV对比并不能证明与Direct相比,额外的候选人生成和汇总呼叫是值得的。
这些是描述性小组内部的比较:政策使用不同的符号限制,C2PRO也改变模型设置,因此图6没有确立一般成本最佳或同等理由的预算政策.

blocks.en:
For LLM ensembles, evaluation should state which counterfactual defines the measured gain, how much candidate information survives the interface, and which effects persist across controls.
Reporting CIV, baseline-specific DSV/CCV, and Rep makes those distinctions visible.
blocks.zh:
对于LLM 综艺节目,评价应说明哪些反事实定义了所计量的收益,在界面中有多少候选信息存在,以及在各种控制中哪些影响持续存在。
报告CIV、具体基准的DSV/CCV和Rep使这些区别明显可见。

blocks.en: 8 Limitations
blocks.zh: 8 限制

blocks.en:
We use selected short-answer benchmarks and mainly answer-level aggregation.
Visible-explanation checks do not cover hidden traces.
Single-slot (C1 slot ) changes coverage as well as distinctness; Duplicate (C3b) changes repetition; neither is a pure causal diversity estimand.
The matched stronger-versus-original contrast changes candidate models and generation settings together, so it is not a model-only effect at equal candidate-generation compute.
Evidence-diversity findings use a single fixed candidate generator on both benchmarks, so their transfer to other generators is untested.
blocks.zh:
我们采用选定的短答基准,主要采用回答层次的汇总。
可见-解码检查不覆盖隐藏痕迹.
单相位(C1插槽)既改变覆盖范围,也改变特性; 二相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相
相匹配的更强与原始对比会共同改变候选模式和生成设置,因此在同等候选生成计算时,它不是一种只使用模型的效果.
证据多样性调查结果在两个基准中都使用一个固定的候选发电机,因此这些发电机转移到其他发电机没有经过测试。

blocks.en:
Headline tests primarily use one aggregator (Luna); Qwen CIV gaps do not establish Qwen Rep.
The human audit is a stratified n = 60 n{=}60 packet and does not demonstrate absence of arm-differential judge error on the matched Single-slot/Duplicate cells; we do not numerically correct main effects.
Aggregation truncation was tracked, and the frozen inclusion policy was retained rather than switching to success-only accuracy.
We do not claim a complete candidate-generation empty/parse-failure comparison between panels beyond the disclosed generation-config differences and aggregation-arm health checks.
blocks.zh:
头条测试主要使用一个聚合器(Luna);Quen CIV空白不建立Quen Rep.
人的审计是分级的n=60n==60包,并不显示匹配的单相/双相格上没有臂-相差判官出错;我们没有数字上正确的主要效果.
跟踪了聚合分流,保留了被冻结的包容政策,而不是转而采用只取得成功的准确性。
我们并不声称除了已披露的生成-配置差异和集合-武器健康检查之外,各小组之间完全进行候选人一代空洞/空洞的比较。

blocks.en:
Candidate-conditioned Rep analyses are exploratory and condition on a post-generation variable.
Slot position/placeholder variants ( n = 60 n{=}60 ) do not prove equivalence of prompt forms.
Later extensions were motivated by earlier findings; they are not all confirmatory.
Public OpenRouter slugs and decoding settings appear in Appendix M ; vendor-internal build IDs remain unresolved.

槽位/位置持有者变体(n = 60 n{=}60)不能证明等同即时表.
后来的延期是因为早先的调查结果;这些结果并非都是确认性的。
